subject: math.FA
name: Hahn–Banach extension theorem
statement: A bounded linear functional on a linear subspace of a real or complex normed space extends to a bounded linear functional on the entire space with the same norm.

subject: math.FA
name: Uniform boundedness principle
statement: Let X be Banach and Y normed. If a family of bounded linear maps X → Y is pointwise bounded, then the operator norms of the family are uniformly bounded.

subject: math.FA
name: Open mapping theorem
statement: Every surjective bounded linear map between Banach spaces is an open map.

subject: math.FA
name: Closed graph theorem
statement: A linear map between Banach spaces is bounded if its graph is closed in the product of those spaces.

subject: math.FA
name: Banach fixed-point theorem
statement: A contraction T of a nonempty complete metric space into itself has a unique fixed point. For every starting point, successive iterates of T converge to that fixed point.

subject: math.FA
name: Riesz representation theorem for Hilbert spaces
statement: Every continuous linear functional on a real or complex Hilbert space H has a unique representing vector v, with F(x) = ⟨x,v⟩ when the inner product is linear in its first variable. Moreover, ‖F‖ = ‖v‖.

subject: math.FA
name: Riesz–Markov representation theorem
statement: If K is compact Hausdorff, every positive linear functional F on the real space C(K) is integration against a unique finite regular Borel measure μ on K: F(f) = ∫ f dμ.

subject: math.FA
name: Baire category theorem
statement: In a nonempty complete metric space, the intersection of countably many open dense sets is dense. In particular, the space cannot be a countable union of closed sets with empty interior.

subject: math.FA
name: Banach–Alaoglu theorem
statement: For a normed space X, the closed unit ball of the continuous dual X* is compact in the weak-* topology, the topology of pointwise convergence on X.

subject: math.FA
name: Krein–Milman theorem
statement: A nonempty compact convex subset of a Hausdorff locally convex topological vector space is the closed convex hull of its extreme points.

subject: math.FA
name: Eberlein–Šmulian theorem
statement: A subset of a Banach space is weakly compact if and only if every sequence in that subset has a weakly convergent subsequence whose limit belongs to the subset.

subject: math.FA
name: Mazur's lemma
statement: If a sequence in a Banach space converges weakly to x, then there are convex combinations of each sufficiently late tail of the sequence that converge to x in norm.

subject: math.FA
name: Hahn–Banach separation theorem
statement: If C is a nonempty closed convex subset of a real normed space and x is outside C, there is a continuous linear functional F such that sup over y in C of F(y) < F(x).

subject: math.FA
name: Hellinger–Toeplitz theorem
statement: An everywhere-defined linear operator T on a Hilbert space satisfying ⟨Tx,y⟩ = ⟨x,Ty⟩ for all x,y is necessarily bounded.

subject: math.FA
name: Closed range theorem
statement: For a bounded operator T between Hilbert spaces, ran T is closed if and only if ran T* is closed. When these ranges are closed, ran T = (ker T*)⊥ and ran T* = (ker T)⊥.

subject: math.FA
name: Lax–Milgram theorem
statement: Let H be a real Hilbert space and a a bounded bilinear form with a(v,v) ≥ α‖v‖² for some α > 0. Every continuous linear functional F has a unique u in H satisfying a(u,v) = F(v) for all v in H.

subject: math.FA
name: Fredholm alternative for compact operators
statement: If K is a compact operator on a Banach space, then I−K is bijective if and only if it is injective. Equivalently, either every equation (I−K)x = y has a unique solution, or Kx = x has a nonzero solution.

subject: math.FA
name: Riesz–Schauder theorem
statement: For a compact operator on a complex Banach space, every nonzero spectral value is an isolated eigenvalue with finite algebraic multiplicity. The only possible accumulation point of its nonzero spectral values is zero.

subject: math.FA
name: Spectral theorem for compact self-adjoint operators
statement: A compact self-adjoint operator on a Hilbert space has an orthonormal basis of eigenvectors, including a basis for its kernel. Its eigenvalues are real, each nonzero eigenvalue has finite multiplicity, and any infinite sequence of distinct nonzero eigenvalues tends to zero.

subject: math.FA
name: Milman–Pettis theorem
statement: Every uniformly convex Banach space is reflexive; that is, its canonical embedding into its double dual is surjective.
